notes: CDER CGMP letter (Warning Letter 320-24-54) for an OTC finished-drug manufacturer: no scientifically sound release specifications/test methods for a two-active-ingredient OTC product, inadequate microbial testing of a (b)(4) component (no objectionable-organism testing besides total aerobic count; firm commits to testing for Burkholderia cepacia complex going forward), and an ineffective quality unit. All drug/ingredient names are redacted as (b)(4), so products is empty and product_redacted is true. Burkholderia cepacia complex is listed in organisms as a genus-species name stated in the letter (per the abbott-laboratories/Similac-probiotic precedent of listing any stated genus-species name), though it is a forward-looking test-method commitment rather than a confirmed contamination finding (contamination_present is false). recall_concern is true given the explicit instruction that substandard retain-sample testing results should trigger 'rapid corrective actions, such as notifying customers and product recalls.'

expected.company: Guangzhou Baiyunshan Jingxiutang Pharmaceutical Co. Ltd.
